Game Overview

Princess Makeover Salon is a dress up game built around join Princess Anna and Elsa for a refreshing makeover adventure. Bring their radiant skin back to life by battling summer woes and pimples. Your expert touch will transform their sadness into glowing smiles, making this beauty experience both fun and rewarding. Ready your brushes and healing potions!
